electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Primary action background, filled CTA buttons, active link borders, selected badge strokes — the single saturated chromatic that drives every conversion and active state

midnight-plum.$description: Midnight Plum — Headline text color, display-weight typography — deep violet-ink that reads as near-black but carries a violet undertone matching the primary

obsidian-charcoal.$description: Obsidian Charcoal — Body text, paragraph copy, list items, icon strokes, default borders and dividers — the workhorse neutral that defines almost all interface line work

slate-smoke.$description: Slate Smoke — Secondary body text, muted helper copy, supporting metadata

pearl-mist.$description: Pearl Mist — Hairline borders on buttons, cards, and inputs; subtle structural dividers

soft-concrete.$description: Soft Concrete — Subtle surface fills, secondary button backgrounds, disabled or recessed controls

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page and card surfaces, button text on violet fills, nav-pill and elevated panel backgrounds

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Decorative pastel accent — painterly background fills, soft highlight washes, illustrative splashes

lime-spritz.$description: Lime Spritz — Decorative pastel accent — painterly background fills, squiggle underline fills, product card surface variation

cotton-candy.$description: Cotton Candy — Decorative pastel accent — soft pink washes, squiggle underline highlights, atmospheric card backgrounds

neon-cyan.$description: Neon Cyan — Badge stroke and informational icon accent — vivid, used in tag outlines and feature flags

lime-pop.$description: Lime Pop — Badge stroke and positive/success-leaning icon accent — vivid green used in tag outlines

magenta-pulse.$description: Magenta Pulse — Badge stroke and energetic icon accent — hot pink for tag outlines and feature highlights

polysans.$description: Display and headline face — custom geometric sans used exclusively for page titles, section headers, and hero copy at heavy weights. The 68px hero size with weight 700 and tight -0.02em tracking is the system's signature: it reads architectural and confident, not friendly. Substitute with General Sans Bold or Plus Jakarta Sans 700 if unavailable.

plus-jakarta-sans.$description: Body, UI, and supporting type — paragraphs at 18px/1.6 weight 400, button labels and nav links at 16px weight 500, badges at 14px, medium emphasis at 500. The 32px size at tight 1.10 line-height appears in sub-section headings. Universal -0.02em tracking pulls it into the same family feel as PolySans.
